subject: A space-age traveler in a sleek silver spacesuit and glowing visor stumbling wide-eyed through a swirling portal of light, one boot still mid-air, a comically startled expression on her face as she arrives in a quaint medieval fantasy town square; cobblestone streets, thatched-roof houses, market stalls, a knight and a market vendor frozen in equally startled reaction, chickens scattering underfoot; the warm torch-lit fantasy town on one side blends into the cool sci-fi glow of the portal on the other, whimsical comedic energy, dynamic composition

A group of adventurers frozen mid-action in a dramatic clash: a swordswoman parrying a blow, a gunslinger firing through swirling smoke, a mage hurling a bolt of raw magic, all lit by the harsh glow of scattered glowing six-sided dice hanging frozen in the air around them like falling stars; a torn rift of light splits the background between a crumbling fantasy hall and a neon-lit alley; dynamic diagonal composition, dramatic action lighting

A vast cosmic vista of three realms hanging in space, connected by threads of shimmering light: a floating fantasy castle on a jagged emerald mountain, a dense neon-drenched cyberpunk metropolis under a starless sky, and a ringed planet with a lone starship drifting past its rings; a small silhouetted figure stands on a rocky outcrop in the foreground gazing up at all three; deep space background with nebulae and stars, epic scale, sweeping cinematic composition
